scope: Bounded read-only schema/aggregate checks of strategy_signals and its declared source references; no exhaustive search of all potential immutable archives.

nonzero_existing_candidate_data.note: These are genuine stored fired events with in-row prices, not fabricated signals or latest-market joins. They are useful candidate source material for a governed archival adapter, but not current contract-qualified replay counts. Rolling30d count differs from earlier838 because the observation boundary advanced.

strict_contract_qualified_subset.qualification_basis: Every inspected strategy signal lacks a supported advisory signal_type; confirmed historical GUID/as_of and availability are also absent. This is not a completed replay metric; no offline archive was exported or executed.

required_field_mapping.reason: A namespaced stable ID may be derived transparently from an actual record identifier. It must retain source_ref/digest; no event ID is currently stored in the replay schema.
Writer sets fired_at at insertion. Retain the actual instant and source provenance; do not substitute scan day, export time or latest-market timestamp.
normalize_signal accepts15explicitadvisorytypes and rejectsGO. GO cannot silently becomeBUY. A validated source-semantic mapping or a true recorded advisory event is required.

required_field_mapping.existing_field: strategy_id plus actual source_record lineage; no native CrossAssetDecisionEvent payload
required_field_mapping.reason: Use actual provenance and recorded facts only. Do not treat backfilled trade-plan fields or scan score as original option economics or probability.

required_field_mapping.existing_field: symbol only; no corresponding native columns or nestedGUID/as_of keys in3JSONcolumns
required_field_mapping.reason: Current symbol lookup cannot by itself prove the confirmed identity known at the historical instant. A retained authoritative point-time identity snapshot is required.

The in-row price was copied from the scan at insertion and is preferable candidate material to a latest-market lookup. Its historical quote/as-of/availability and identity must be retained/proven before export. Do not relabel scan/execution time as market quote time.

required_field_mapping.existing_field: signal_score/riskplanfields and routingmetadata; no contracted option/equity expression fact snapshots
required_field_mapping.reason: The contract can count signal/price coverage without these facts, leaving all option economics unproven. Scores/probabilities must not be synthesized fromsignal_score or backfilledriskplans.

required_field_mapping.existing_field: shares/plan fields are not an as-of held-position snapshot
required_field_mapping.reason: Do not infer actual holdings, broker positions or covered-call eligibility from a proposed shares count.

availability_and_immutability_limits: strategy_signals has no created_at/available_at, identity_guid or identity_as_of column. All2707rows have0top-level and0recursiveGUID/as_of/available_at presence in inspectedJSONfields.
strategy_signal_sync uses a plainINSERT and sets fired_at while copying scanprice. Existing source also updates plan/description fields later; the whole row is not an immutable decision envelope.

The declared lineage resolves to trade_ai_scans. The bounded required-field metadata query found id/symbol/price/source, and no security_guid/subject_guid/identity_status/as_of/available_at among queriedkeys. Other scan timing columns were not exhaustively queried; no inference of immutable source availability was made.

market_ohlcv_bars andticker_prices have market/ingestion times but no GUID/available_at. Earlier observed writers upsert existing prices/bars and include late ingestion. They were not joined to construct point-time proof in this task.
Currentlatestmarketdata andmutableaction_signals_history were not used. Source journal/backup versions and other potential immutable archives remain NOT_MEASURED in this bounded assessment.

minimum_archiver_and_operator_decisions.action: Define a transparent adapter from one genuine stored advisory event or validate the actualGOsource semantics. Preserve unsupportedGOasunsupporteduntil justified; do not auto-mapGOtoBUY.

Preserve immutable event envelope with stable source record ID/digest, event_observed_at and actualavailable_at; confirmedidentity GUID/status/identity_as_of/source_ref; equityquote marketas_of andavailable_at/source_ref. Do not backdate missing facts.

Build an explicit offline adapter validating the contractedsignals.jsonl/prices.jsonl and an immutable manifest containing capturedwindow/as_of, sourcequery/recordprovenance, exactfileSHA256, counts andrefusals. No scheduler, productionwriter or flag activation.

Choose the governed archive source/root, retention and any new authorityregistry grant before creating a production archival writer. Start from real capturedfacts; preserve missingfacts and failures. No model choice is needed for metadata/exportvalidation.

Leave optionalposition/expressionfacts absent when notproven. Signal/pricecoverage counts may become nonzero after strictfacts exist; reportINSUFFICIENT_DATA, financial_actionfalse andnullsuperiority.

If pricedoptioncomparisons are desired, archive actual timestampedcontracts/bid/ask/expiry/strike/right/liquidity and governingquoteavailability, plus authorized point-timeexpressionassumptions. Summary-onlyoptionsrecords cannot satisfy this and no liveprovidercall is implied.
